description: Verify count claims over loan status ('N in special servicing / paid off / defeased') for a deal. Counts are DERIVED from the ABS-EE tape, not reported by any filing. Three grains, never mixed: activity (active, resolved_paid_off, defeased); servicing: in_special_servicing = loans CURRENTLY with the special servicer (the count for 'N in special servicing'; it OVERLAPS active, never sum); resolution reason (resolved_via_special_servicing and other payoff reasons) = loans that already LEFT the pool, NOT current counts. Pass `claimed` for exact per-status adjudication. Uncovered deal: UNVERIFIED.

claimed.description: Optional claimed per-status counts, e.g. {"in_special_servicing": 10, "defeased": 2}. Each is adjudicated by EXACT match against the derived count.

name: verify_loan_status_counts

statuses.description: Per status: status, grain, count, claimed, claim_verdict, receipt.
